article.title: Rime發布Prism語音模型，以可檢視文字層支援企業對話控制
article.title_en: Rime launches Prism with an inspectable text checkpoint for enterprise voice agents
article.summary: Rime於10月28日公布Prism語音對語音模型，描述可在說話前產生供檢查的文字層，並讓工具呼叫與語音並行；自助微調API仍與beta客戶共同開發。
article.summary_en: Rime announced Prism on October 28, describing a speech-to-speech model with an inspectable text layer before speech and tool calls alongside spoken output. Self-service fine-tuning APIs are still being developed with beta customers.
article.why: 對使用語音代理承接諮詢與訂單的品牌，文字檢查點值得評估：能否在客戶聽到回覆前套用品牌用語與動作限制，比聲音自然程度更關乎流程控制。
article.why_en: Brands using voice agents for inquiries or orders can evaluate whether a text checkpoint supports wording checks and action limits before a response reaches the customer.
article.next_step: 以一個低風險對話檢查人名、產品詞、拒答及執行前確認；向供應商確認語言、部署與微調開放條件。
article.next_step_en: Test names, product terms, refusals and confirmation before action on a low-risk workflow; confirm languages, deployment and fine-tuning access with the supplier.
highlights: Rime把Prism描述為聆聽、寫出將說的內容並在說話時繼續聆聽的系統。
文字層可供規則檢查及修改；自助RL與SFT API尚在與beta客戶開發。
highlights_en: Rime describes a system that listens, writes its intended response and continues hearing the user while speaking.
The text layer can be checked and rewritten; self-service RL and SFT APIs are being built with beta customers.
article.detail:
Rime於10月28日公布Prism語音對語音模型，描述可在說話前產生供檢查的文字層，並讓工具呼叫與語音並行；自助微調API仍與beta客戶共同開發。

Rime把Prism描述為聆聽、寫出將說的內容並在說話時繼續聆聽的系統。

文字層可供規則檢查及修改；自助RL與SFT API尚在與beta客戶開發。

對使用語音代理承接諮詢與訂單的品牌，文字檢查點值得評估：能否在客戶聽到回覆前套用品牌用語與動作限制，比聲音自然程度更關乎流程控制。

以一個低風險對話檢查人名、產品詞、拒答及執行前確認；向供應商確認語言、部署與微調開放條件。

能力為供應商自述；本刊未重現語音評測。官方及其他報道的延遲口徑不同，本刊不刊載速度比較或全面微調可用聲稱。
article.detail_en:
Rime announced Prism on October 28, describing a speech-to-speech model with an inspectable text layer before speech and tool calls alongside spoken output. Self-service fine-tuning APIs are still being developed with beta customers.

Rime describes a system that listens, writes its intended response and continues hearing the user while speaking.

The text layer can be checked and rewritten; self-service RL and SFT APIs are being built with beta customers.

Brands using voice agents for inquiries or orders can evaluate whether a text checkpoint supports wording checks and action limits before a response reaches the customer.

Test names, product terms, refusals and confirmation before action on a low-risk workflow; confirm languages, deployment and fine-tuning access with the supplier.

Capabilities are vendor-reported and voice evaluations were not reproduced. Differing latency descriptions are excluded, as are claims of universal fine-tuning availability.
